description: 指定避難所等一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 京都市. 京都市の指定避難所，緊急避難場所，広域避難場所及び災害救助拠点の一覧です。. Coverage: 京都市. The portal files it under the publisher 京都市. Its tags are 京都市. It offers 4 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
